entries.en: Farewell.
Greetings!
Of course, just have a look.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, sólo eche un vistazo.

entries.en: Farewell.
Here is the list with the missing ingredients to complete the ritual.
entries.translated: Aquí tienes la lista con los ingredientes que faltan para completar el ritual.

entries.en: See you my friend.
Hello. I'm so glad someone has found me. Did you meet THEM?!
entries.translated: Hola. Me alegro mucho que alguien me haya encontrado. ¡¿Los conociste?!

entries.en: See you my friend.
Good .. bye.
Where .. am I?
Good .. bye.
Greetings, friend. Good you are showing up.
entries.translated: Saludos amigo. Qué bueno que estás apareciendo.

entries.en: Hey there, you are surely interested in helping the Rathleton city guard, right? Right - especially now since the dreaded minotaurs gain more ground every day.
entries.translated: Hola, seguramente estás interesado en ayudar a la guardia de la ciudad Rathleton, ¿verdad? Claro, sobre todo ahora que los temidos minotauros ganan cada día más terreno.

entries.en: Have a nice day.
Have a nice day.
Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
entries.translated: Cuídate mucho viajero. Sería una pena perder a un vagabundo tan valiente ante esos monstruos verdes.

entries.en: How could you sneak up on me like this? I thought you were one of THEM! Well, since you are not, what brings you to this wilderness?
entries.translated: ¿Cómo pudiste acercarte sigilosamente así? ¡Pensé que eras uno de ELLOS! Bueno, ya que no lo eres, ¿qué te trae a este desierto?

entries.en: Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
entries.translated: Cuídate mucho viajero. Sería una pena perder a un vagabundo tan valiente ante esos monstruos verdes.

entries.en: Hi! You look like someone on a {mission}.
Be greeted, friend of the apes.
entries.translated: Sea saludado, amigo de los simios.
